review_scope: Independent read-only review of all six complete artifacts, receipts and tool-event traces, exact request and packet, both complete helper receipt files, five TSV fixtures, frozen A/B skill, regression, scorer and routing sources, and the CEOPT-01 frozen scenario.
overall_judgment: All six model artifacts pass the bounded evidence-interpretation request. A helper behavior fails three supplied safety cases; B helper behavior passes all five supplied cases. Full frozen acceptance remains partial because executed legacy classification alias equivalence is missing.

trials.rationale: Correctly overrides three unsafe A STABLE receipts, explains exact classification and dimension mismatches, withholds acceptance for unknown classification, and limits the stable control to supplied performance evidence.

findings.detail: Initially attempted a nonexistent references/regression.md, then discovered and read the correct regression.md. The recovered lookup does not invalidate the final artifact.

trials.rationale: Accurately reports B outputs and distinguishes descriptive TSV fields from authenticated test evidence. Explicitly notes that legacy eligible classification compatibility is source-supported but unexercised.

findings.detail: Initially attempted a nonexistent references/regression-workflow.md, then read the correct regression.md. Recovery is visible in the trace.

trials.rationale: Correctly explains HARD early exit, visual equivalence, invalid-classification rejection and limited stable coverage. Separates TSV unknown classification from consecutive orchestrator unknown-unit cycles.

findings.detail: The first guessed regression reference was nonexistent. A later successful read establishes the final source claim; the combined command's exit zero alone would not establish that every preceding read succeeded.

trials.rationale: Correctly identifies the three false-green mechanisms and requires source correction and evidence-backed resolution. Its proposed future checks are not represented as completed checks.

findings.detail: Recovery item 2 permits explicit alias rejection as an alternative, but frozen acceptance requires lawful legacy aliases to remain equivalent. Item 3 correctly requires equivalent behavior for both eligible and visual spellings; implementation must follow that stronger requirement.

trials.rationale: Correctly rejects unsafe A verdicts and explicitly leaves downstream recovery/check behavior untested.
Accurately reconciles every receipt with source and fixtures, preserves alias equivalence, rejects invalid classification, and limits preservation claims to scorer inputs.

A.hard: Fail: exit 0 STABLE despite regression-eligible HARD regressed=true. The blocking filter accepts only literal eligible.
A.visual-ui: Fail: exit 0 STABLE at 100 because the scorer recognizes only visual, discards the supplied visual-ui dimension from aggregation, and renormalizes performance alone.
A.unknown: Fail: exit 0 STABLE at 100 over two performance cells because SCORE aggregation does not validate classification.
A.stable: Pass within scope: exit 0 STABLE at 100 for one performance cell.

B.hard: Pass: exit 1 UNSTABLE with the functional HARD blocker. Numeric performance cannot override it.
B.visual: Pass: exit 1 UNSTABLE at 60, with identical output to visual-ui.
B.unknown: Pass: exit 2 INVALID_INPUT, row 2 unknown classification, empty stdout and no stability verdict.
B.stable: Pass within scope: exit 0 STABLE at 100 for one performance cell.
B.source_explanation: B normalizes visual-ui to internal visual and eligible to regression-eligible, validates classification and registry tier, and scores only admitted classifications. The supplied receipts exercise visual normalization and unknown-classification rejection, but not legacy eligible normalization.

helper_mechanism_conclusions.stable_boundary: Unavailable flakiness, resource and visual dimensions have not passed. Unrepresented HARD dimensions are not demonstrated. Synthetic display values and status=ran do not authenticate application execution.

integrity_and_trace_checks.trace_read_coverage_method: Decoded every tool-event payload and verified that the complete current contents of each claimed source, fixture and arm receipt occur in recorded tool outputs.
integrity_and_trace_checks.observed_operations: Only local cat, rg and ls reads/listings. No helper execution, test execution, mutation, network or delegation appears in the model traces.
limitations: These traces show observed behavior, not enforced filesystem isolation.
Hash agreement verifies supplied artifact consistency, not independently authenticated serving identity or provenance.
Receipt metadata claims unchanged parent saving; the supplied tool-event traces do not contain the final assistant messages needed to independently compare pre-save and saved final text.
The packet still says prepared-not-executed; per-trial receipts and traces provide execution evidence, so that packet status is stale.

recovery_and_check_obligations.judgment: Adequately identified across all six artifacts; not executed.
required: Preserve original evidence and resolve unknown classification from baseline evidence without deleting or relabeling it merely to pass.
For actual HARD regressions, establish green-to-red evidence and 3/3 reproducibility before bisecting; authorized fixes require shrinking blockers and final full-battery re-gating.
Treat visual failures as SCORE differential investigations, not automatic HARD bisect.
Validate the persisted ledger and re-screen the exact pinned predicate before resume.
Prevent convergence while relevant errors, unresolved failures, coverage gaps or pending independent verification remain.
Keep unknown TSV classification distinct from orchestrator unknown units and their repeated-cycle blocking rule.
Do not infer ship authorization from STABLE.
recovery_and_check_obligations.preservation_supported: The supplied helper receipts report scorer input preservation and scratch cleanup; matching input hashes corroborate current fixture identity.
recovery_and_check_obligations.preservation_not_supported: Orchestrator recovery, check-state preservation, ledger mutation correctness, resume behavior and successful convergence remain untested.

missing_frozen_facets.facet: Executed lawful legacy classification alias equivalence
missing_frozen_facets.missing_evidence: A matching fixture pair using classification=eligible and classification=regression-eligible, with actual helper receipts. All supplied TSV rows use regression-eligible except the intentionally unknown row.
missing_frozen_facets.impact: Visual alias equivalence is demonstrated, but the complete lawful-alias acceptance clause cannot be closed from these five fixtures.

missing_frozen_facets.missing_evidence: The supplied negative fixture covers unknown classification only; no unknown dimension execution is supplied.
missing_frozen_facets.impact: The narrow claim unknown classification does not turn green is demonstrated for B. A general unknown-values rejection claim would exceed these receipts.

model_versus_parent_scope.model: Six read-only interpretation artifacts. A models correctly diagnose and refuse unsafe helper output; B models correctly interpret safer helper output. No model autonomously executed scoring, repaired state, saved a durable artifact, or completed an orchestrator loop.
model_versus_parent_scope.parent: Prepared synthetic fixtures and arm-specific helper receipts, then saved final model artifacts according to receipt metadata.
model_versus_parent_scope.acceptance_separation: A model judgment can pass while the A deterministic helper fails. Three model interpretations of the same arm receipt are not three independent helper executions.
model_versus_parent_scope.broader_parent_goal: This review cannot close full CEOPT-01 frozen acceptance, remaining skills, runtime integration, field outcomes or publication.

comparison_limits: Both arms achieve 3/3 correct scoped model decisions; these artifacts do not demonstrate a model-quality superiority claim.
The deterministic helper shows a concrete improvement on three supplied negative cases, separate from model judgment quality.
A and B consume different helper receipts and regression contracts; this is not an isolated prompt-only comparison.
Trial starts follow A1, B1, B2, A2, A3, B3, but A3 and B3 overlap. Treat timing as deadline admission, not a controlled sequential latency experiment.
Three repetitions per arm, synthetic fixed fixtures, unauthenticated serving identity and absent token/cost measurements do not establish generalized quality, latency or cost improvement.
No real application, visual rendering, upstream baseline capture, orchestrator recovery or deployment outcome is demonstrated.
